reason: Note speaks of the fourteenth and fifteenth of Adar kept with assembly and gladness; that is 10:13.
Note speaks of the fixed assembly of the fourteenth and fifteenth of Adar before Yahuah; that is 10:13.
Note's point is the two lots coming 'at the day of judgment' — the words of 10:11 (10:10 only makes the lots). Stays.
Note: 'the nation saved when it cried' — 10:9's 'cried to Yahuah, and were saved'.
Note: 'delivered them from all those evils' — 10:9's own words.
Note: the confession that Yahuah saved his people — 10:9.
Note: the fall of Aman and his assembled nations — 10:8 names the nations assembled to destroy.
Note: the nations assembled to destroy the name of the Yahudim — 10:8 verbatim.
Note: Aman the second dragon — 10:7 'the two dragons are I and Aman'.
Note: the dream that failed in nothing — 10:5.
Note: nothing of the dream had failed — 10:5.
Note: the little fountain that became a river — 10:6.
Note: Haman's plot to send a people 'in one day' into the grave — 13:7's 'may in one day with violence go into the grave'.
